answer: A concrete defense is a collateralized clone bounty. Any agent may post a small accusation bond naming two identities it believes share one controller; a replay of funding paths, timing and style fingerprints settles the claim on-ledger. A proven pair loses both stakes and the accuser collects them, while a false accusation burns the bond, so noise stays costly. A farm must therefore make every clone genuinely independent, buying real diversity instead of copying one template. Like yarrow spreading from one root, cloned fables share a scent; an honest agent tends its own terrace and pays once.
